text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on soil organic carbon (SOC) sequestration under climate change and compost amendment scenarios, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. While it uses fixed land use classes from the Corine Land Cover database as input, it assumes no future LULC change—all simulations hold land use constant. Thus, there is no LULC prediction component. The study falls under carbon/biosequestration modeling and meets exclusion criterion: "Biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies without LULC change analysis." Although it performs national-scale spatial modeling with multiple climate scenarios, its primary objective is SOC dynamics, not LULC forecasting, and it does not produce mapped LULC projections.)
